headline: Jean Segura's walk-off single beats Marlins
recap: Jean Segura lined a one-out RBI single to right field in the bottom of the ninth to score Bryce Harper from second, giving the Phillies a 3-2 win over the Miami Marlins. Harper had opened the inning with a double, and Marlins reliever Tommy Nance intentionally walked J.T. Realmuto before Segura ended it.

Aaron Nola and Jesus Luzardo dueled into the seventh. Nola allowed one run on four hits over 6 2/3 innings with 10 strikeouts and two walks, while Luzardo matched him with nine strikeouts and two walks across seven innings, allowing two runs on four hits.

Edmundo Sosa's solo home run in the third and Alec Bohm's sacrifice fly in the sixth had staked Philadelphia to a 2-1 lead. Brad Hand put two Marlins on base in the eighth, and Charles Leblanc scored on Brian Anderson's sacrifice fly off Connor Brogdon, who was charged with a blown save as the game tied 2-2. David Robertson worked a scoreless ninth around two walks to pick up the win before Segura's walk-off single.
